skill.summary: Enables incognito mode to suppress and securely erase all agent memory writes and session traces upon deactivation, leaving no persistent record.

latestVersion.changelog: Tighten env var safety: reject OPENCLAW_HOME/WORKSPACE set to home root ($HOME) — must be a strict subdirectory. Clarify required vs optional: only python3 is hard required; env vars and shred are optional with documented defaults. Qualify 'files you create remain untouched' claim with env var scoping caveat.
